definitions.name: def-e993tailb
definitions.canonical: Literal polynomial (1+X)^a+X. Exact source definition in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993tailn
definitions.canonical: Sum of the m branch arities. Exact source definition in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993tailh
definitions.canonical: One plus the sum of orders2,4,7 for arities2,3,4. The fallback7 applies only to4 under the hypothesis. Exact source definition in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993tailc
definitions.canonical: B1 times all original branch factors. Exact source definition in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993tailu
definitions.canonical: B1 times marked B_(ri-1) times the product over all j distinct from i. Exact source definition in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993taile
definitions.canonical: X times (1+X)^N. Exact source definition in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

conclusion.canonical:
theorem e993_guarded_tip_surplus_tail
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 100 ≤ m) (r : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i = 2 ∨ r i = 3 ∨ r i = 4)
    (i : Fin m) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hguard : 2 * k ≤ e993TailN r + 2) :
    0 < ((e993TailH r : ℝ) + 1) * (e993TailU r i).coeff k * (e993TailC r).coeff k +
      ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((e993TailH r : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 1) *
        ((e993TailE r).coeff k * (e993TailC r).coeff k -
          (e993TailE r).coeff (k + 1) * (e993TailC r).coeff (k - 1))
